$comment: Shared vocabulary every other batch references by name: the glossaries, the funnel-stage
terms, the scope-category terms, and the twelve perspectives. Must run first (see
../_folder_order.json) — the questions batch links its terms into these glossaries, and
survey definitions scope themselves against them.
Canary is keyed on qualified_name, which for Perspectives is author-controlled in
foundations.md itself (no generated org prefix or version, unlike glossary terms — see
type is 'Perspective', a subtype of Actor (confirmed with Dan; both 'Perspective' and
'Actor' resolve it, 'ActorProfile' does not). Recorded because it is genuinely non-obvious:
the type names you would first reach for — GlossaryTerm, ValidValueDefinition, Collection —
all MISS, and a wrong type_name yields a false 'missing' rather than an error. That is the
dangerous failure mode here: a false missing triggers a heal, and a spurious heal of the
survey-definitions batch duplicates step links and takes those definitions out of service.
The bootstrap therefore treats type as optional and matches on qualified_name alone when it
is absent, since qualified_name is globally unique by Egeria convention.
'Perspective::Admin' is the LAST element foundations.md creates, so its presence means the
document ran to completion rather than merely starting.
